plan.gap: No measured discharge (L/s or m³/h), drip-tape length/rate, soil-moisture threshold, or calculated irrigation-cycle duration for alfalfa was found. Only a seasonal volume (14 cm at Becker, MN) appeared without per-cycle breakdown, flow, pressure, or tape specs.
queries: alfalfa drip irrigation cycle duration flow rate discharge L/s university extension
alfalfa trickle tape irrigation scheduling application rate mm per event measured discharge

requirements.need: A source must present a measured irrigation-cycle duration calculation for alfalfa derived from actual discharge/flow-rate input (L/s or m³/h per tape length), not inferred or generic recommendations.

Original units (discharge, tape length, emission rate, irrigation-depth-per-event, or soil-moisture threshold) must be explicitly stated with geography and crop stage; seasonal totals alone do not satisfy the intent.

Evidence must refer specifically to alfalfa (Medicago sativa) irrigation management, not grasses or legumes generally, and must distinguish applied water from crop-water-use (ETc) rather than conflating the two.
